# opnsense_dhcrelay_destination (Resource)

DHCP servers that relayed requests are forwarded to (**Services ▸ DHCP Relay ▸ Destinations**).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dhcrelay_destination" "central" {
  name   = "central-dhcp"
  server = ["10.0.0.67", "10.0.0.68"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the destination.
- `server` (Set of String) DHCP server addresses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the DHCP relay destination.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_dhcrelay_destination using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_dhcrelay_destination.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_dhcrelay_destination using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_dhcrelay_destination.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
